mac-2-qa.purpose: Independent QA, device/performance checks and UAT coordination

mac-3-integration.purpose: Serialized source integration and release preparation; no owner approval or store signing

rules: Use a distinct worker token and dedicated macOS account per machine.
Only mac-3-integration receives GitHub write credentials.
No worker receives owner browser cookies, store signing keys, Cloudflare admin credentials or release approval authority.
All three workers may share private artifacts only through an explicitly configured private synchronized directory.
A capability declares dispatch eligibility, not proof that a physical device or SDK exists.
